'All changes saved' shown; final GET returned salary_process.attendance_source = null (matches baseline). MongoDB direct check also shows {'salary_process': {'attendance_source': None}}. Kankani ends the run exactly as it started.

critical_code_review_comments: firm-master.tsx (L1329-1362) — clean UI: radio group binds directly to sp.attendance_source; PATCH body sends attendance_source: null when 'Not Set' is chosen (o.k === ''), which the backend correctly interprets as unset.

attendance-policy.tsx SalaryDaysSourceCard (L2442-2515) — self-saving card is nicely encapsulated: reads via GET /admin/firm-master/{id}, writes via PATCH with body { salary_process: { attendance_source: k || null } }. Rollback on error (setSrc(prev)) is a solid touch.
Both screens share the SAME storage path (firm_masters.salary_process.attendance_source), so there is zero risk of two-way divergence. Sync verified in both directions.

Minor UX polish (optional): the Attendance Policy 'Saved ✓ (Firm Master synced)' message stays visible until the user picks another option. Consider auto-fading after ~3s so the card doesn't retain a stale confirmation. Not a defect.
